summary: Modules that explain your key as one subject understands it, in the language you use Vocabularium in.

steps.title: Reads your key in any language
steps.text: A term, a phrase or a sentence, in whatever language you met it.

steps.title: Explains it as the subject does
steps.text: In short, plain words for a learner, often with a small example, written in your interface language.

steps.title: Says when a key is outside the subject
steps.text: A neighbouring field's term is named as such and explained briefly; an unrelated key gets one honest sentence.
